description: The chart displays the distribution of four categories across three difficulty levels: easy, medium, and hard. Each pie chart represents a difficulty level and is divided into four slices, corresponding to the categories N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, and N+K-. The easy chart has four slices: N+K+ (green, 55.4%), N-K+ (yellow, 38.3%), N+K- (red, 1.7%), and N-K- (orange, 4.6%). The medium chart also has four slices: N+K+ (green, 58.8%), N-K+ (yellow, 35.4%), N-K- (orange, 4.0%), and N+K- (red, 1.8%). The hard chart is similarly divided: N+K+ (green, 37.3%), N-K- (orange, 37.9%), N-K+ (yellow, 18.1%), and N+K- (red, 6.7%). A legend on the right side of the chart indicates the color corresponding to each category. The percentage labels are shown inside each slice, and no slices are visually emphasized. The slices in each chart are not ordered in a particular way.
